parameters.prompt: The exact flying falcon in the reference performs ONE heavy downward wing slam while hovering in place. From the hovering pose it raises both wings high above the body, then beats both wings down hard once while the body dips slightly lower with the talons pushed down, holds the low pose for a brief moment, then rises back and returns to the exact original hovering pose and holds it. Keep the same three-quarter left view, plumage, beak and wing shape. Exactly two wings and two legs. The body stays upright with the chest and face toward the camera the whole time and never rolls or tilts sideways. Only ONE wing beat; after it the wings glide back up slowly. No flying across the frame, turning around, rolling over, showing its back, diving, landing, second beat, flapping repeatedly, extra limbs. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.
